chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: Hazel Myers and Lucille Hegamin
summary: Hazel Myers was the leading singer in Steppin' High; Lucille Hegamin recorded in New York alongside Mamie Smith while her husband played piano.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: How about blues singer Hazel Myers? Was she from here?
No, Hazel Myers came out, and they were featuring her in "Steppin' High." She was the leading singer in "Steppin' High,"
And how about Lucille Hegamin? You...every time Hegamin's name comes up, you...
...you always...you always say, "That's Lucille's husband." Was Lucille better known than...much better than...
Oh, Lucille was...she made records like right along with Mamie Smith. See? Lucille Hegamin, she made a lot of records right along in that area, but her husband was the piano player. Hegamin.
Did she record out here--or back East?
New York. They lived in New York. They were just out here for a short while.
